_comment: Release.String() display renderings across the Series/Release hierarchy: family[-generation][/release]. The bare-line and un-named-release rows pin that an empty segment is OMITTED ENTIRELY rather than rendered as a dangling separator.

provenance.ref: the worked Series/Release example: llama-4 line, scout release

mutation.description: renders a fully-populated release: family, generation and release name
uses a DOTTED generation, so a normalization that dropped the .0 would redden

provenance.ref: a versioned line with no named release

mutation.description: empties the release name, so only the series renders

provenance.ref: an un-versioned line with no named release

mutation.description: empties BOTH the generation and the release name, the fully degenerate rendering

provenance.ref: a named release on an un-versioned line

mutation.description: restores the release name while leaving the generation empty, so the separator must still appear
